description: Lists a page of labels for a GitLab project, with optional filtering by name, archived status, and ancestor inclusion.

archived.description: If true, returns only archived labels. If unset, returns all labels.
archived.title: Archived

id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project. Can be a numeric ID (e.g., 123) or namespace path in format 'namespace/project-name' (e.g., 'my-group/my-project').
id.title: Id

include_ancestor_groups.description: Include labels from ancestor groups. Defaults to true.
include_ancestor_groups.title: Include Ancestor Groups

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of labels per page. Defaults to 20.
per_page.title: Per Page

search.description: Keyword to filter labels by name.
search.title: Search

with_counts.description: Whether or not to include issue and merge request counts. Defaults to false.
with_counts.title: With Counts

name: list_labels

closed_issues_count.description: Number of closed issues with this label. Only included when with_counts=true.
closed_issues_count.title: Closed Issues Count

is_project_label.description: Whether this label belongs to the project (not inherited).
is_project_label.title: Is Project Label

open_issues_count.description: Number of open issues with this label. Only included when with_counts=true.
open_issues_count.title: Open Issues Count

open_merge_requests_count.description: Number of open merge requests with this label. Only included when with_counts=true.
open_merge_requests_count.title: Open Merge Requests Count

priority.description: Label priority. Null if no priority is set.
priority.title: Priority

subscribed.description: Whether the current user is subscribed to this label.
subscribed.title: Subscribed

text_color.description: Text color for the label in hex format (e.g., #FFFFFF).
text_color.title: Text Color

labels.description: List of labels for the project.
labels.title: Labels
